parts.name: fallback
parts.role: initials or placeholder icon when image missing

structurePatterns.text: sans uppercase initials, scaled to size

pixelVariant.font: fallback initials use var(--font-pixel) when pixelStyle=pixel
pixelVariant.degrade: without --font-pixel, initials fall back to var(--font-sans) uppercase

usageHints.whenToUse: User profile pictures, author attribution, comment lists
usageHints.accessibility: Include alt text on image; fallback must present initials
usageHints.doNot: Do not use avatar alone as the only user identifier in dense lists

pixelLayer.note: Pixel fusion only swaps the avatar's fallback initials to Fusion Pixel. The circular frame and sizes stay editorial. No .avatar-pixel class.
